SELECT pa.account_id, pa.user_id, pa.balance, pa.total_earned, pa.total_spent, pa.today_earned, pa.last_update_date, pa.create_by, pa.created_at, pa.update_by, pa.update_time, pa.remark, u.nick_name FROM sys_points_account pa LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.user_id = pa.user_id
AND pa.user_id = #{userId}
AND u.nick_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{nickname}, '%')
ORDER BY pa.balance DESC

SELECT pa.account_id, pa.user_id, pa.balance, pa.total_earned, pa.total_spent, pa.today_earned, pa.last_update_date, pa.create_by, pa.created_at, pa.update_by, pa.update_time, pa.remark, u.nick_name FROM sys_points_account pa LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.user_id = pa.user_id WHERE pa.user_id = #{userId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_points_account (user_id, balance, total_earned, total_spent, today_earned, last_update_date, created_at, updated_at, create_by, create_time, remark) VALUES (#{userId}, 0, 0, 0, 0, #{lastUpdateDate}, NOW(), NOW(), #{createBy}, #{createTime}, #{remark})
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_points_account SET balance = balance + #{points}, total_earned = total_earned + #{points}, today_earned = IF(last_update_date = #{date}, today_earned + #{points}, #{points}), last_update_date = #{date}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE user_id = #{userId}
